title: Rory and the Velvet Mossy Glade
verses:
The sun sank down behind the hill,
And painted clouds of gold,
While Rory walked the forest trail,
As evening breezes rolled.

Then Tilly found a quiet nook,
Beneath a leafy dome,
Where happy ferns and clover leaves,
Provided cozy home.

And Benny stretched his heavy legs,
Upon the mossy ground,
So tired and warm and settled in,
Without another sound.

Then Ricky stopped his bouncing games,
And tucked away his feet,
To listen to the evening crickets,
Singing soft and sweet.

High up above the sleepy trees,
Nia began to glide,
And watched the shadows softly fall,
On every forest side.

With Psittaco asleep at last,
Upon a leafy bed,
The starry blanket covered up,
Each heavy sleepy head.
